# waroom_user (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom user. Look the user up by exactly one of `sub`, `nickname` or `slack_user_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a user by nickname.
data "waroom_user" "by_nickname" {
  nickname = "alice"
}

# Look up a user by the ID of the linked Slack user.
data "waroom_user" "by_slack_user" {
  slack_user_key = "U0123ABCD"
}

# Look up a user by sub.
data "waroom_user" "by_sub" {
  sub = "auth0|abc123"
}

# Use the looked-up sub in an on-call rotation instead of hard-coding it.
data "waroom_user" "alice" {
  slack_user_key = "U0123ABCD" # or nickname = "alice"
}

resource "waroom_on_call_team" "platform" {
  name  = "Platform"
  color = "1E90FF"

  rotations = [
    {
      timezone              = "Asia/Tokyo"
      started_at            = "2026-01-05T10:00:00+09:00"
      shift_handoff_time    = "10:00"
      shift_handoff_wday    = 1
      participant_user_subs = [data.waroom_user.alice.sub]
    },
  ]

  lifecycle {
    # Lookups also return deactivated users and invitees, and only users who have
    # verified their phone number can join a rotation.
    precondition {
      condition     = data.waroom_user.alice.status == "active" && data.waroom_user.alice.phone_verified
      error_message = "User ${data.waroom_user.alice.nickname} is not active or has not verified a phone number."
    }
  }
}

# Build an on-call rotation from Slack user IDs instead of hard-coding subs.
# Only active users who have verified their phone number can join a rotation,
# so fail at plan time when one of them has not.
locals {
  sre_slack_user_keys = ["U0123ABCD", "U0456EFGH"]
}

data "waroom_user" "sre" {
  for_each       = toset(local.sre_slack_user_keys)
  slack_user_key = each.value

  lifecycle {
    postcondition {
      condition     = self.status == "active" && self.phone_verified
      error_message = "User ${self.nickname} is not active or has not verified a phone number, so cannot join an on-call rotation."
    }
  }
}

resource "waroom_on_call_team" "sre" {
  name  = "SRE"
  color = "1E90FF"

  rotations = [
    {
      timezone              = "Asia/Tokyo"
      started_at            = "2026-01-05T10:00:00+09:00"
      shift_handoff_time    = "10:00"
      shift_handoff_wday    = 1
      participant_user_subs = [for key in local.sre_slack_user_keys : data.waroom_user.sre[key].sub]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `nickname` (String) The user's nickname. Nicknames are unique in an organization.
- `slack_user_key` (String) The ID of the Slack user linked to the user (e.g. `U0123ABCD`). Null when the user is not linked to Slack.
- `sub` (String) The user's subject identifier (e.g. `auth0|abc123`), which identifies a user in Waroom.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the user was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) User ID. This is an alias for `sub`.
- `phone_verified` (Boolean) Whether the user's phone number is verified. Only verified users can be added to on-call rotations.
- `picture` (String) The URL of the user's profile picture.
- `status` (String) The user's status: `active`, `inactive`, `invited`, `invitation_pending`, `invitation_failed` or `deactivated`. Users in every status can be looked up, so check that the user is `active` before adding them to an on-call rotation.
